name: Aditya Singhal
description: Aditya (Adi) Singhal builds and evaluates AI agents with MCP. Applied Scientist at Amazon, former AWS Bedrock engineer, and agentic AI instructor at NYU.
biography: I'm Adi, an Applied Scientist at Amazon and a former AWS Bedrock engineer. I work on agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and RAG systems. I also teach an Agentic AI workshop every year at NYU.
